incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — SEV2: partial multi-region failover observed. us-west-2 experienced control-plane routing errors and we have a stuck traffic-shift. On-call: @maya. Runbook: <https://runbooks.redwood.local/multi-region-failover>. Please acknowledge and follow the failover checklist. thread_ts=1736654321

maya: on it, taking pager. joining bridge. seeing spike in 5xx for hosted API and some Dedicated pools in us-west-2. traffic-shift to us-east-1 was auto-initiated at 1736654300 but ~30% of requests still land in us-west-2 and get 502/503.

tj: @maya acked. can you paste routing errors or logs from the edge? suspecting BGP or NAT gateway blackholed routes in that AZ.

maya: copying snippets — edge proxy logs show upstream connect errors + ETIMEDOUT. also control-plane reports failure to advertise new routes for subset of hosts. sample log:```
[1736654312] upstream_connect_error: connect_timeout to 10.2.5.123:443
[1736654313] cluster_tcp_conn: failing over to fallback cluster us-east-1
```

jordan: I ran a quick DNS probe — different resolver pools still returning us-west-2 A records for api.redwood.ai. looks like DNS propagation and long-lived caches are keeping traffic pinned. sample dig from 3 resolvers:```
; <<>> DiG 9.11.3 <<>> api.redwood.ai @8.8.8.8 A +short
52.24.11.5  # us-east-1
; <<>> DiG 9.11.3 <<>> api.redwood.ai @1.1.1.1 A +short
34.210.2.11 # us-west-2 (stale)
; <<>> DiG 9.11.3 <<>> api.redwood.ai @9.9.9.9 A +short
52.24.11.5
```

lee: TTL on the DNS record is 300s but some resolvers appear to be ignoring it or holding older entries. If the LB still advertises backends in us-west-2, caches + LB will keep sending traffic. I'm going to remove us-west-2 backends from the LB pool to accelerate failover. prepping manual change.

ops-bot: running command to disable backend in us-west-2:```
gcloud compute backend-services update redwood-api-backend --global --remove-backend group=us-west-2-group --project=redwood-prod
```

maya: trying a graceful drain on nodes servicing Dedicated tenants in us-west-2 but hit a PDB-blocking pod that won't evict; `kubectl drain` failed on node wg-3 due to critical PDB. snippet:```
error: eviction blocked: PodProtectionPolicy prevented eviction: critical-service-pod (pdb minAvailable=1)
```

sam: CS update — multiple customers reporting intermittent 500s since ~1736654280. Dedicated customers in us-west-2 show latency spikes and some timeouts. I'm preparing a customer advisory for the affected accounts.

cust-success: sending notification to top 5 affected customers now. including interim mitigation note: failover in progress, intermittent errors expected, will update within 15m.

maya: handoff — I need to join a customer bridge in 2m. I'm handing primary to @tj for network/edge work. I'll remain available for escalation.

tj: taking primary. net-eng: reaching out to CDN provider (pager) for edge cache purge and to confirm whether any regional POPs are still serving stale DNS/route mapping. running `traceroute` and `curl -I` for headers.

tj: `curl -I https://api.redwood.ai/health` from an external probe returns:```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
server: redwood-edge
x-cache-status: MISS
x-origin-region: us-west-2
x-cache-control: max-age=300
```
Indicates origin still responding from us-west-2 for some requests.

jordan: I submitted CDN purge for `api.redwood.ai` and `*.redwood.ai`. request id: purge-8732. provider confirms purge queued — ETA ~90s.

tj: confirmed purge completed. also requested forced re-resolve on our front-tier proxies. I'm removing remaining us-west-2 backends from LB and will monitor 5xx rate.

incidents-bot: Update: manual backend removal executed at 1736654480 by lee. Auto-rollback prevented. Escalation: network team engaged.

sam: after backend removal, traffic hitting us-west-2 dropped from ~30% -> ~3% over ~4m. 5xx rate decreased from 12% -> 2% for general traffic. Dedicated customers with pinned capacity in us-west-2 still show residual errors (we're coordinating dedicated failover).

maya: thanks team. I'll take notes for the incident timeline. creating incident ticket and assigning followups: DNS TTL investigation, LB change checklist, PDB eviction strategy, dedicated-customer migration playbook.

tj: final check: edge errors cleared, CDN purge fixed cache skew. I'll continue monitoring for 30m and then hand back to rotation.

maya: handing back to rotation. great work. Incident severity remains SEV2 until dedicated tenants confirm green. will draft customer postmortem and RCA.

incidents-bot: Incident update logged. Actions: create RCA, follow-up item for reducing DNS TTL before auto-shifts, and improve PDB eviction guidance for drains. Assigned-to: maya, tj, lee. :white_check_mark:
